messages:
Alex: Heads-up — deploybot scheduled a big migration tonight at 03:00 UTC for `user_events`. It's a row-copy backfill (~2h). Need to confirm quiesce window, canary strategy, and an explicit rollback trigger. :clock3:
Jamie: thanks. what's the plan for reads during backfill? will we freeze replicas or maintain read-only? :eyes:
Sasha: plan is serial canary: 1) canary node on prod5 (traffic 0.5%) 2) staggered backfill waves (10m gap) 3) promote if canary health ok. We'll freeze writes to affected shard during swap, not reads.
Priya: we should pin the frontend DB client to 2.13.7 during the migration. previous bump had a query plan change that trips the backfill. Jamie can you coord the pin?
Jamie: yes, I'll pin a canary app pool for the window. also adding a feature-flag gate `user_events_migration_v2` to flip post-success.
Alex: deploybot posted the job config — sharing snippet:```/deploy run job=migration-user-events time=03:00UTC canary=1 canary_region=prod5 stagger=10m freeze_replicas=true backout_script=rollback_backfill_v2.sh```
Sasha: preflight checks: schema diff assert, sample-run against shadow replica, replication lag < 250ms, CPU < 70% on GPU hosts (jk, just normal infra). If any preflight fails, abort.
deploybot: preflight passed on staging. runbook link: https://redwood.infra/runbooks/migrations/user_events_v2
Priya: rollback criteria proposal: abort and run backout if any of: 1) canary error rate > 1% 2) replication lag > 5s sustained for >2min 3) unexpectedly large row churn (>10x estimate). Also manual abort allowed by oncall.
Alex: agreed. Add an escape hatch to allow immediate pin to prior migration flag and open read-only on the affected table for 30m if abort triggers. Document the exact commands in the runbook.
Jamie: logging/alerts: send canary stderr to #incidents and create a temporary trace in APM tagged `migration-user_events-<ts>`. I'll add those alert rules.
Sasha: small nit — when we do the swap, we must ensure KV cache invalidation across regions. I'll add a step to flush prefix `uevents:` post-swap.
deploybot: noted. Job scheduled at 1714525200 (03:00 UTC). I'll post status pings to this thread during the run. :robot_face:
Alex: perfect. final checklist for tonight: pin client (Jamie), feature flag gate (Jamie), preflight run (Sasha), runbook & alerts (Priya), cache invalidation step (Sasha). Oncall: @sasha will be primary, @jamie backup.
Priya: copy. I added a quick rollback command in the runbook: `./rollback_backfill_v2.sh --force --snapshot=pre_mig_171450` — tested on staging.
Jamie: one more — release notes snippet for customers: "Maintenance window: user events indexing; write quiesce for up to 2 hours; read availability maintained." I'll draft and ping marketing after deploy.
Alex: thanks all. Ping here 30m before start and again at canary completion. :pray:
